issues.basis: A persistent kernel-held serve.guard replaces PID-based ownership. Stale live/reused PID receipts do not own a lock. Concurrent cleaners cannot unlink a new owner. PID receipts are replaced atomically; launchers stop the legacy helper before binary replacement.

issues.basis: Native HT cleanup/refinement segmentation across quality layers remains algorithm work. Header/memory guards and layer-1000 sentinel correction do not repair pass routing; no claim based on unrelated HT images.

SFTP v3 cannot make LSTAT-to-operation atomic against independent server-side path swaps; server account/chroot confinement remains required for that threat.
